business_summary: AXIS Capital Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides various specialty insurance and reinsurance products in Bermuda, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Insurance and Reinsurance. Its Insurance segment offers professional insurance products that cover directors' and officers' liability, errors and omissions, employment practices, fiduciary, crime, professional indemnity, medical malpractice, environmental liability, and other financial insurance related coverages for commercial enterprises, financial institutions, not-for-profit organizations, and other professional service providers; and property insurance products for commercial buildings, residential premises, construction projects, property in transit, onshore renewable energy installations, and physical damage and business interruption following an act of terrorism. This segment also provides marine and aviation insurance services for offshore energy, offshore renewable energy, ocean marine, cargo, liability, including kidnap and ransom, fine art, specie, and hull war, hull and liability, and specific war coverage for passenger airlines, cargo operations, general aviation operations, airports, aviation authorities, security firms, and product manufacturers; personal accident, travel insurance, specialty health products for employer and affinity groups, and pet insurance products; and liability, cyber, and credit and political risk insurance services. The Reinsurance segment offers agriculture, marine and aviation, catastrophe, accident and health, credit and surety, motor, professional, travel, life, engineering, property, and liability reinsurance products. AXIS Capital Holdings Limited was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Pembroke, Bermuda.
business_summary_ko: AXIS Capital Holdings Limited는 자회사를 통해 미국 버뮤다 및 국제적으로 다양한 전문 보험 및 재보험 상품을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 보험과 재보험이라는 두 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 보험 부문은 이사 및 임원의 책임, 오류 및 부작위, 고용 관행, 신탁, 범죄, 직업적 손해 배상, 의료 과실, 환경 책임 및 상업 기업, 금융 기관, 비영리 조직 및 기타 전문 서비스 제공자를 위한 기타 금융 보험 관련 보장을 다루는 전문 보험 상품을 제공합니다. 상업용 건물, 주거용 건물, 건설 프로젝트, 이동 중인 재산, 육상 재생 에너지 설비, 테러 행위에 따른 물리적 손상 및 사업 중단을 위한 재산 보험 상품입니다. 이 부문은 또한 납치 및 몸값, 미술품, 정금 및 선체 전쟁, 선체 및 책임을 포함한 해상 에너지, 해상 재생 가능 에너지, 해양 해양, 화물, 책임, 여객 항공사, 화물 운영, 일반 항공에 대한 특정 전쟁 보장에 대한 해양 및 항공 보험 서비스를 제공합니다.
